title: People & Pronouns
description: How characters say I, you and who, plus the family and title words that show up in every show.

words.sentence: [{俺|おれ}]に{任|まか}せろ！
words.tip: The tough-guy 'I'. Protagonists of battle shōnen love it.

words.sentence: [{僕|ぼく}]は{逃|に}げない。
words.tip: Gentler than 俺. Used by polite boys and young men.

words.sentence: [{私|わたし}]の{名前|なまえ}はサクラです。
[{君|きみ}]は{誰|だれ}だ？
words.tip: 君 has 口 (mouth) under a hand holding a staff: a ruler giving orders. Now it's a casual 'you'.

words.sentence: [お{前|まえ}]、{何|なに}してるんだ？
words.tip: Literally 'the one in front (前) of me'. Rude to strangers, close between friends.

words.sentence: [あなた]を{信|しん}じています。
[{彼|かれ}]は{強|つよ}い。
[{彼女|かのじょ}]は{魔法使|まほうつか}いだ。
あの[{奴|やつ}]は{危険|きけん}だ。
words.tip: Originally 'servant' (女 + 又 hand). Now a blunt word for a person or thing.

words.sentence: [みんな]、{行|い}くぞ！
そこにいるのは[{誰|だれ}]だ？
[{何|なに}]が{起|お}きた？
words.tip: Read なに or なん depending on what follows: 何が (なにが), 何ですか (なんですか).

words.sentence: ここは[どこ]？
words.translation: Where am I? (lit. where is here?)

words.sentence: [なぜ]{戦|たたか}うんだ？
words.tip: More dramatic than どうして. Villains love asking なぜだ！

words.sentence: [{自分|じぶん}]を{信|しん}じろ。
words.tip: 自 is a nose. In Japan you point at your nose to mean 'me'.

words.sentence: [{家族|かぞく}]を{守|まも}りたい。
words.translation: I want to protect my family.

words.sentence: [{兄|あに}]は{騎士|きし}だ。
words.translation: My older brother is a knight.
words.tip: A big mouth (口) on legs: the older brother who bosses you around.

words.sentence: [お{兄|にい}ちゃん]、{待|ま}って！
[{姉|あね}]は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}だ。
words.translation: My older sister is good at cooking.

words.sentence: [{先生|せんせい}]、{質問|しつもん}があります。
words.tip: 先 (ahead) + 生 (born): someone born before you.

words.sentence: [{師匠|ししょう}]、{技|わざ}を{教|おし}えてください！
words.translation: Master, please teach me the technique!

words.sentence: {魔王|まおう}[{様|さま}]、ご{命令|めいれい}を。
words.tip: Much more respectful than さん. Also in 神様 (god) and お客様 (honored customer).
